final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM account GROUP BY district_id), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM account GROUP BY district_id)) SELECT step1.district_id, step1.cnt, CAST(step1.cnt AS REAL) / step2.total as ratio FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
